_comment: Copy the 'mcpServers' block into your host app's config, then restart it.
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with the real path to this folder -- these apps do not
expand ~ or run from your project directory, and a relative path will fail
silently with no error in the UI.
Run `which python3` and use that exact interpreter -- the one with the 'mcp'
package installed. A venv python is fine; the system one often is not.
